question: Nine people, 1 to 9, are sitting in a straight row, facing the north. 8 is sitting in the middle of the row and his immediate left and right neighbours are 5 and 1, respectively. 9 is sitting at one of the extreme ends and his immediate right neighbour is 2. Only five people are there between 2 and 3. 3 is sitting between 7 and 6. 1 and 7 are immediate neighbours. How many people are there between 4 and 6?
solution:
**Given:**

Nine people, 1 to 9, are sitting in a straight row, facing the north.

**Solution:**

 
• 8 is sitting in the middle of the row . This means that 8 is at 5th position.

 
 
• ​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c38a7d63b0d7c8703e7a89d187af164368084fa2b5dd4ca0e360dfe52a06118c.png] 
 
 
 
• ​his immediate left and right neighbours are 5 and 1 .Means 1 is at 6th position and 5 is at 4th position.
 
 
• ​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba7b1a6536853e9d1c4ae7df263efaccf9953e95e28a6c094736bf1eaa95623c.png] 
 
 
 
• ​. 9 is sitting at one of the extreme ends and his immediate right neighbour is 2.
 
 
• ​9 must be at position 1st or 9th , 2 is right neighbour . There are two cases:
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/520b947ada0850fdf257446d85ca1783d934eb1a72639814c04bc0500f726d70.png] 
 
• Case 2 is not possible so we will consider case 1.
 
 
 
• ​Only five people are there between 2 and 3.
 
 
• ​This means 3 is at 8th position.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ffdace804a94fe76de0c4a87575270d15e3f36d1b23a660ba9dd9a6ea3eca371.png] 
 
 
 
• 3 is sitting between 7 and 6.. 1 and 7 are immediate neighbours.
 
 
• ​There are two possible cases
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a877159e59e333b2130ffa3999d6b385ae6f554599aa16fec349edc570a76ac2.png] 
 
• As 7 and 1 are immediate neighbours , case 2 is not possible.
 
• The last vacant space will be occupied by 4.
 
 
 
• People between 4 and 6 are.
 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5287aa42f07bf4a2f8a159783c441d63d51e158262459a49c030fa278a736fbe.png] ​
 
• There are 5 people between 4 and 6
 
 

**The correct answer is 'Option 3' .**
